environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed on ECS Fargate with PostgreSQL 14 on RDS. The database connection uses role `app_reader` which has been explicitly configured with `ALTER ROLE app_reader SET row_security = on; NOINHERIT; NOBYPASSRLS`. A separate pgbouncer sidecar in transaction-mode pooling intercepts connections and issues `RESET ALL` followed by `SET ROLE app_reader` on each transaction checkout via a server_reset_query_always=1 configuration. The ECS task definition specifies a stopTimeout of 120s with a custom entrypoint that traps SIGTERM and drains in-flight requests before propagating. Additionally, the RDS instance has a custom parameter group with `pgaudit.log = 'all'` and a Lambda-backed CloudWatch alarm that triggers on any query returning rows where tenant_id doesn't match the session variable.

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')::uuid)
config.rls_force_enabled: ALTER TABLE documents FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
config.role_security_setting: ALTER ROLE app_reader SET row_security = on
